notes.title: Announcing: New, free zombie mode in Prison Simulator!
notes.content:
[h1]Attention Guards![/h1]


[h2]A New Challenge Awaits![/h2]

Survival meets prison in the brand-new Zombie Mode for Prison Simulator! 

This [b]free [/b]expansion puts you in the boots of a prison guard fighting for survival as the facility descends into chaos!

When a mysterious infection sweeps through the inmate population, turning them into mindless, flesh-hungry monsters, you’ll have to use every tool at your disposal to hold the line.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/6d6e5387e2983d0423f34e52aca8363af53b35cb.png[/img]

[h2]🧟Waves of Undead Inmates🧟[/h2]

Forget about your old guard's routine - this is all-out war!
Zombie Mode introduces an intense  zombie survival system, where each room is a new round of increases number and ferocity of the infected prisoners! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/f669158baec3a7760b5fa29f8bbe487098b5a73f.jpg[/img]

-More blood-soaked action

-Gruesome new zombie models

Follow us for more updates!

notes.title: Daily Deal on Prison Simulator! Full version is now on a 31% discount on Steam!
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome Players and Officers[/h2]

Greetings, fellow gaming enthusiasts!

If you've ever found yourself captivated by the inner workings of a penitentiary, the trials faced by inmates and correctional officers, and the intricacies of maintaining law and order within its walls, then look no further than the enthralling world of [i]Prison Simulator![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38933921/47127fb4d15b1d732aed6e71679328d7fb610749.png[/img]

And now, there's an exciting reason to immerse yourself in this captivating experience as the game is currently available on Steam with a fantastic -31% discount!
Don't miss this golden opportunity to explore the thrilling life of a [i]Prison Simulator[/i] while keeping some extra cash in your pocket!

[h3][b]A Glimpse into Realistic Gameplay:[/b][/h3]
Prison Simulator provides a unique and lifelike simulation of life inside a correctional facility. As a player, you will step into the shoes of a prison guard, shouldering the responsibility of managing daily operations and maintaining order among the incarcerated population.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38933921/5177954bd1a2d57f2bb00cec194514a0b1fb9d93.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]New mode available![/b][/h3]

Last Man Standing - absolutely new and [b]free [/b]mode in [i]Prison SImulator[/i]! You will find yourself in the rioting prison! Your only chance is to escape !! (quite an irony, right?)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38933921/4768ae54be6d512a6500c84b19b06412de24be9b.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Confront Real Challenges:[/b][/h3]

Prepare to face numerous challenges that mirror the actual realities of running a correctional facility. Your decisions and actions will impact the delicate balance between maintaining order and ensuring the well-being of the inmates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38933921/f3d4d4e43b53c93bb40fc3cad8411d1837cc6847.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Unleash Your Creativity with the In-Game Prisoner Creator:[/b][/h3]

Unleash your creativity by designing your own prisoners and bestowing them with unique characteristics! You can even personalize a prisoner's appearance by uploading a photo of your friend or foe – imagine the fun of seeing their faces within the game! ;)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/842180/Prison_Simulator/

Best regards,
Baked Games Team

notes.title: We are celebrating! - Prison Simulator is now 1 year old!
notes.content:
[h1]Officers! Welcome! We have an important message![/h1]


Hello there dear Players!
Our hit game - [b]Prison Simulator [/b]came out in [b]November 4th 2021[/b] so you know what that mean? 
[b]That Prison Simulator is 1 year old !!![/b]

Boy it was quite a ride! Delivering such funny and entertaining simulator for players!
We are very happy that Prison Simulator bringing joy for Players on all world ;)
We are still working on some updates for it!

In the year after release we updated our game a few times -[b] let's check everything what we was working on! [/b]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/bd8262a30f176dd7ba9ba0a07bb0db4a4d0b0698.png[/img]

[h2]New skins![/h2]
We added some cool skins for prisoners! You can change their appearance in warden’s PC !
I like the “classic prisoner” skin the most ! ;)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/ab1faa6c866496f224a2a9e383fe95829bc019d7.png[/img]
“Classic Prisoner” skin
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/d765d204d81c3c50d5366820c538bb05009bfcc6.jpg[/img]
”Slavic outfit” skin 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/d765d204d81c3c50d5366820c538bb05009bfcc6.jpg[/img]
„Octopus game” skins
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/9709313fdb026025b31c6b83386427c9ea9d42ea.png[/img]

[h2]New Twitch mode!![/h2]
Something for streamers!
Set it up in options, start streaming on twitch.tv and see how it comes out!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/bec5e709196ec9fad8ba41a3f2a596c5c7ebe803.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/95420d1a7dc3f0057599427f355cb2b6eaa58acd.gif[/img]
How it works? After certain guard’s routine starts, viewers can vote in chat with commands for some events to start! Like prisoner attacking player or putting something on fire !
Various routines have different possible commands! Check it out!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/5a18673a6ca92e9543488a1e70f121fac9440334.gif[/img]

When voting is over the command will execute in game! It’s a new funny way to integrate with community!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/5360e7f8d024a4ca1ebd0d9b806c09427b355014.gif[/img]

[h2]Three new routines ![/h2]

[b]Laundry [/b]– do the cleaning to show them who is the boss ! 😉 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/01c5429500fd77956b3e0eeb564c0dc73f655c8e.gif[/img]

[b]Nightshift routine [/b]- Be ready to visit your beloved work place at night! A prison at night can be sp00ky and something weird can happen :o
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/8be66feefb8e18352fa09542645a003c8b4d2783.gif[/img]

[b]TV Room routine [/b]-  Select some prisoners you want to give some chill time in
social room with TV! Choose carefully because some inmates don't like each other and they can cause some destruction !
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/88245e3caab244ab1fd34c688d6bb2c2e5a547e5.gif[/img]
[h2]
Improved riot event![/h2]
New things can happen in riot so be careful! But you will also receive a new weapons like shotgun!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/a3a6e63bf59496a397bd33ed54f06c18d052578b.gif[/img]

[b]Dangerous prisoners [/b]with stolen weapons and guns can also appear on riot! 
There are like some kind of  mini-bosses!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/a6d649b35cb6ba3e52a63179ebaa547d3a7935da.gif[/img]

[h2]Steam Deck and gamepad support![/h2]
[b]Prison Simulator[/b] is also now fully compatible on [u]Steam Deck [/u]!
Also we added gamepad support for more comfortable playing!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/6f4689a479dfbba035ed2e1495802f4ddb82e6d2.png[/img]

[h2]New update available soon![/h2]
And that’s not all! We are still working on the game new features and on new [b]“Last Man Standing” [/b]mode where you must escape from new prison before rioting prisoners get you ! More info about this new mode in previous devlogs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/8d3748c84f82d4a96bb0aaf54802da9b6f567ac2.gif[/img]

[h2]Youtubers and influencers support![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/83b5fd5f53c1ad1a89c9d9408a32a10ddea96aff.gif[/img]

Our game is quite popular on Youtube ;)
Here you can see a short GIF with [b]Markiplier[/b] but there was a looot of others and we 
wanna thank all creators for making such funny videos from our game :D
It the best feeling for every dev - to see that your work bring some people some joy !

[h2]Brand new game about prison riots![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/e50a36de1866fbc6042cb505f6c7d23f9bff0892.gif[/img]

We are also started developing a new game concentrating about riots in various prisons!
4 player coop action! Check it out !

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1874980/Ready_for_Riot/

[h3]Thank you for reading and thank you very much for playing our game!!! 
Be ready for a new chapter in Prison Simulator game! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/93a901026a4d1bee374cbb782382e96afd234931.png[/img]
Watch our social medias especially [url=https://twitter.com/Baked_Games]Twitter[/url] and join our Discord for more behind the scenes footage ;)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/842180/Prison_Simulator/


Best regards,
Baked Games Team

notes.title: Details about new update coming to full version of Prison Simulator!
notes.content:
[h1]Players and Officers! New important informations about full version of [b]Prison Simulator[/b] ![/h1]

Hello and welcome to the devlog about our new mode we are adding in Prison Simualtor!!
We are working now on several things right now and one of it is a absolutely [b]new[/b] mode in Prison Simulator! This new mode will be distributed [b]for free[/b] ! 

[h2]Last Man Standing - what are the rules?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/4768ae54be6d512a6500c84b19b06412de24be9b.gif[/img]

The rules is simple - get out of prison alive !! The vile riot is destroying prison facility. You have no other choice but to escape ! (it's funny that the guard must escape prison, right?)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/97843b0c3248075f4a2d63364312878868e6375e.gif[/img]

This mode is actually action-oriented. We know that you liked a Riot Event from full game a lot ;) so we added some more action in prison for fans ;)

[h2]Getting started[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c4838c3406dbde0b3bfdbaafe439a55f6585f700.gif[/img]

First you will find yourself without weapons or items in small office...  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/dbf8530693e68a355ec8a6be395dd607d943654c.gif[/img]

You got only your trusty fists! Fight your way out! Persuading won't help you this time - prisoners are mad and wants your blood!! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/14c31b852f600897d6b5a223a7cb25f7ffe99c18.gif[/img]

Use fists to fight! Remember you can press RMB to defend yourself. But watch a [b]stamina bar[/b] !!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/bc142de2c3a6ebf5cd4ee2812c46086ef76218f7.gif[/img]

Also you can HOLD an attack button to charge a powerfull PUNCH ! No one can resist that !

[h2]This is where a fun begins![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/7d14e81c23e2edf8b54ed8172869e3933615a493.gif[/img]

Fortunately in this mess and riot you can still find some usefull items. A riot gun is mandatory, i haven't finished this mode without it ever once :D  
And don't worry about prisoners health - it works on non-lethal bullets !

[h2]Stronger enemies[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/b34e4a92cfa13fb1f0888ef1f26c924d3d9cfd09.gif[/img]

In one of the updates we added some stronger prisoners to Riot Event. 
Unfortunately they came back for more!! Watch out for mini-bosses with stolen body armor and weapons and also for a tricky ones with GUNS!! Most dangerous ones! You have to defeat them in order to progress through some rooms

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/34cfd1c505fc0b8beae4021e2d3b421d89fa51d9.gif[/img]

[h2]Entarily new prison![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/45d99ce905fb10090f67e57d06e3322c01866328.gif[/img]

We made a entairly new prison for this mode ! It was fun making it ! Hope you won't get lost ;)
After escaping (or after death) you will get a pop up with some informations of how well did you 
did. You know: time passed, prisoners neutralized etc. Try to aim for the best score!

I hope this mode will get you some challenge and fun! It's [b]almost[/b] ready to be published, please be patient and wait for some more info about future of Prison Simulator - you won't be dissapointed ;)

notes.title: Prison Simulator: Catching fire and bug fixes.
notes.content:
[b]Hello Officers,[/b]

Looks like us inmates have found a new way to have fun. Richard caught one of them setting fire to prison property. We're sure it's all to burn us with this building. Be careful out there. This is a warning to remember. Fire is no fun! Fire is to be avoided. 

I am decreeing new rules for our prison! No matches or lighters of any kind, including smokers.

Objection? No problem! If you get burned, you'll stop complaining.

Your best warden.

We would like to tell you, that we are so proud of you -  our community. Everyday you help us to improve our game. Thank you!

notes.title: Prison Simulator: Sometimes our inmates like to stink
notes.content:
[b]Hello Officers,[/b]

Do you think it is the end of your shift? Because what? Friday? Well.. yes, it is the end of the shift for today. This is the best time to relax, and stop thinking about prisoners.

But actually we have something to tell you before you go home.

There are some routines, that are not available in the Prison Simulator: Prologue. One of those routines is Shower time!

[b]Sometimes our inmates like to stink.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/f5a2f2c5f3c1e555556b1b7fe76774767d7aaef2.png[/img]

Well. Not everyone likes to shower. Anyway, your job is to send as many prisoners to the showers as you can. Keep in mind, however, that these inmates may have a lack of patience, and that may result in fights and unnecessary arguments.

Give them towels and wait. Then take dirty towels from them and repeat. Be aware of fights and try to keep calm. You can do it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/3ea406f0a7ad0f67e0c79c115f0de5cead0d7bfa.png[/img]

*This update contains screenshots that were taken in engine and do not represent the current look of the game.

[h3]Have a nice weekend Guys![/h3]

By the way... May the soap be with you!

tags.feature: One of those routines is Shower time!

notes.title: Prison Simulator: Prologue - Making of: The riot
notes.content:
[h3]Hi players![/h3]

Today we're going to talk about  creating a riot scene and mechanics for our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431610/Prison_Simulator_Prologue/][b]Prison Simulator: Prologue.[/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/df59331a2b88dfaee7aadb7a76f445a4871b63f2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/b3220da2cc469cf5790ab1b2bdeaeff7c851bd77.gif[/img]

To make the game as interesting as possible, we spent many hours planning new dialogues, mini-games, and rearranging many rooms.

All this allowed us to create an atmosphere that with the addition of lights makes you feel as if you were there. 

On the attached materials you can see the places affected by the outrageous behavior of the convicts. We also decided to show you that some rooms will be locked and you won't get inside until you open the locks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/7c8d6e4915cf4b524ba984e7a77e5e22b9263f74.gif[/img]

notes.title: Prison Simulator Update - Player skills
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome, guards![/h1]

[h2]A few days ago our prison received funding to train our wonderful staff. You can be the lucky ones and take part in the trainings. The prize?[/h2]

[h3]The skill tree was divided into two tabs - active and passive skills. They are different from each other, but both categories are very helpful during a shift in our prison.[/h3]

[h3]The currency is skill points and money. Unfortunately no one will do it for free.[/h3]

[h3]Your colleague will be waiting in the Social Room. Talk to him for more information. Now take a look at these resources:[/h3]

[h3]Of course, some skills have several levels, but we won't tell you the details. We want you to have this surprise effect![/h3]

[h2]Now get to work and add our prologue to your wishlist! 
Cheers! :)[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431610/Prison_Simulator_Prologue/

notes.title: Prison Simulator Demo Update - small fixes, prologue and congratulations!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Guards![/h1]

[h2]First and the biggest thing is that we have updated our demo! We fixed a few smaller bugs and achievements issues. Now everything should be fine![/h2]
[h3]
We are still working on our Prologue. It is very important for us because we want to show you the best game we can! Riot has to be impressive and effective.[/h3]

[h3]Going back to our demo, we prepared some surprises. We won't tell you what is that but if you find those easters you can let us know on our Discord.[/h3]

notes.title: Happy St. Nicholas Day, bug fixes and about our Prologue
notes.content:
[b][h1]Good Morning Guard![/h1][/b]

[h2]Again Monday, again your shift again you can't sleep all day. Don't worry, we know that this is the hardest day of the week, but we have a new update for you![/h2]

[h2]Today we will focus on 3 things:[/h2]

[h3]- St. Nicholas day (which was yesterday 6th of Dec)
- Bug fixes
- and we will tell you a bit more about our Prologue[/h3]

[h2]Stay with us![/h2]

[h1]6th of December - Saint Nicholas Day. [/h1]

[h2]It is a tradition in our country to celebrate this day. We give each other a small gifts like sweets or something like that. Our prisoners also had a great time. Maybe it is only the beginning before something much bigger? Who knows.. who knows.[/h2]

[h1]Bug fixes [/h1]

[h2]We've fixed many bugs you reported on Discord or via email. [/h2]

[h3]- Needle is no longer not reachable in a chocolate bar
- We have change a general balance
- Stats section in briefing is showing 4 the best stats of the day
- New Prisoners are fully implemented to the game[/h3]

[h1]Prison Simulator: Prologue[/h1]

[h2](don't forget to add the prologue to your wishlist if you want to get a notification just a second after the release)[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431610/Prison_Simulator_Prologue/

[h3]We have been working on our Prison Simulator: Prologue for a few months. It will be available on Steam for free and it will show you the events just before the full version of the game. We have taken some screenshots for you. Take a look:[/h3]

[h3]Cheers :)[/h3]

notes.title: NEW PRISONERS IN PRISON SIMULATOR
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Guards,[/h1]

[h3]It is Friday (not Monday as always). What does it mean? We have something very important for you![/h3]

[h3]Recently, we've been working so hard and for a long time to change one of the key things in our game. We decided to recreate prisoners but with glasses, tattoos, hair and other elements of human traits![/h3]
